disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct as defined in the chapter
Any violation of the chapter or rules adopted pursuant to the chapter or an order issued by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of this chapter or ORS 680.010 to 680.205, of rules adopted pursuant to this chapter or ORS 680.010 to 680.205 or of an order issued by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or permitting unacceptable patient care due to a deliberate or negligent act or failure to act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in or permitting the performance of unacceptable patient care by the dentist or by any person working under the supervision of the dentist due to a deliberate or negligent act or failure to act by the dentist, regardless of whether actual injury to the patient is established.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making use of advertising statements that are deceptive, misleading, or untruthful

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action by a state licensing or regulatory agency of this or another state regarding a health care profession with demonstrable relationship to ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action by a state licensing or regulatory agency of this or another state regarding a license to practice dentistry, dental hygiene, dental therapy or any other health care profession when, in the judgment of the board, the act or conduct resulting in the disciplinary action bears a demonstrable relationship to the ability of the licensee or applicant to practice dentistry

establishment_regulation_required.quote: Only a person licensed as a dentist by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may own, operate, conduct or maintain a dental practice, office or clinic in this state.

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the healing art concerned with: (A) The examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, treatment, care and prevention of conditions within the human oral cavity and maxillofacial region, and of conditions of adjacent or related tissues and structures; and (B) The prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs for purposes related to the activities described in subparagraph (A) of this paragraph.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the healing art concerned with: (A) The examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, treatment, care and prevention of conditions within the human oral cavity and maxillofacial region, and of conditions of adjacent or related tissues and structures; and (B) The prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs for purposes related to the activities described in subparagraph (A) of this paragraph.

value: cutting, altering, repairing, removing, replacing or repositioning of hard or soft tissues
prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs
methods_authorized.quote: "Dentistry" includes, but is not limited to: (A) The cutting, altering, repairing, removing, replacing or repositioning of hard or soft tissues and other acts or procedures... (B) The prescription and administration of vaccines.

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe, dispense and administer prescription drugs for purposes related to the practice of dentistry, including vaccines.
drug_authority.quote: The prescribing, dispensing and administering of prescription drugs for purposes related to the activities described in subparagraph (A) of this paragraph.

specialist_license_available.quote: A dentist licensed by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may advertise that the dentist is a specialist in one or more areas of dentistry if the dentist: (a) Has completed a post-doctoral residency program that is at least two years in length and is accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A license issued to an applicant qualifying for a dental instructor's license who is a specialist by virtue of successful completion of an advanced dental education program is restricted to the specialty in which the dentist was trained.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means supervision requiring that a dentist diagnose the condition to be treated, that a dentist authorize the procedure to be performed, and that a dentist remain in the dental treatment room while the procedures are performed. ... "General supervision" means supervision requiring that a dentist authorize the procedures by standing orders, practice agreements or collaboration agreements, but not requiring that a dentist be present when the authorized procedures are performed. ... "Indirect supervision" means supervision requiring that a dentist authorize the procedures and that a dentist be on the premises while the procedures are performed.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A dental therapist may practice dental therapy only under the supervision of a dentist and pursuant to a collaborative agreement with the dentist that outlines the supervision logistics and requirements for the dental therapist's practice.

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: A dentist may supervise and enter into collaborative agreements with up to three dental therapists at any one time.

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: Upon application accompanied by the fee established by the Oregon Board of Dentistry, the board shall grant a permit to practice as an expanded practice dental hygienist

value: Patients or residents of nursing homes, adult foster homes, residential care facilities, adult congregate living facilities, mental health residential programs, facilities for persons with mental illness or developmental disabilities, correctional facilities, and public and nonprofit community health clinics who are unable to receive regular dental hygiene treatment
Students or enrollees of nursery schools and day care programs and their siblings under 18, Job Corps, primary and secondary schools, and Women Infants and Children Program beneficiaries
Patients in hospitals, medical clinics, medical offices or offices operated or staffed by naturopathic physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates or midwives
Patients whose income is less than the federal poverty level
Other underserved populations as determined by the Oregon Board of Dentistry
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: An expanded practice dental hygienist may render all services within the scope of practice of dental hygiene, as defined in ORS 679.010, without the supervision of a dentist and as authorized by the expanded practice dental hygienist permit to: (a) Patients or residents of the following facilities or programs who, due to age, infirmity or disability, are unable to receive regular dental hygiene treatment

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: The Oregon Board of Dentistry shall issue a license to practice dental therapy to an applicant who: (a) Is at least 18 years of age

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist may practice dental therapy only under the supervision of a dentist and pursuant to a collaborative agreement with the dentist that outlines the supervision logistics and requirements for the dental therapist's practice.

value: Practice settings specified in the collaborative agreement
At least 51 percent of practice dedicated to underserved populations or dental care health professional shortage areas
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist shall dedicate at least 51 percent of the dental therapist's practice to patients who represent underserved populations, as defined by the Oregon Health Authority by rule, or patients located in dental care health professional shortage areas

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Only a person licensed as a dentist by the Oregon Board of Dentistry may own, operate, conduct or maintain a dental practice, office or clinic in this state.

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A dentist may not use the services of any person who is not licensed to practice dentistry in this state to make, provide, repair or alter dental prosthetic appliances or other artificial materials or devices that are returned to a dentist and inserted into the human oral cavity, or that come into contact with the human oral cavity's adjacent structures and tissues, unless the dentist first provides to the person a work order

teledentistry_authorized.quote: A dental care provider authorized by the Oregon Board of Dentistry to practice dental care services may use telehealth if: (a) In the professional judgment of the dental care provider, the use of telehealth is an appropriate manner in which to provide a dental care service

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: This section does not authorize an expanded practice dental hygienist to administer nitrous oxide except under the indirect supervision of a dentist licensed under ORS chapter 679.

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: An expanded practice dental hygienist must successfully complete a training course approved by the board under this section before performing interim therapeutic restorations under ORS 680.205 (3)(d).

patient_record_retention_years.quote: A dentist shall retain for at least two years from the date of prescription a duplicate copy of each work order prescribed by the dentist.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: Presents documentation satisfactory to the board of successful completion of an emergency life support course for health professionals, including cardiopulmonary resuscitation, from an agency or educational institution approved by the board

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Upon application accompanied by the fee established by the Oregon Board of Dentistry, the board shall grant a permit to practice as an expanded practice dental hygienist
